metadata.description: Internal-app create (pkg), captured live via tools/internalapps-capture against <internal-env>/26.2.1614.12 (app id 65679); anonymized via mock-capture's Anonymize() before commit. DOCUMENTATION-ONLY in TestGeneratedInternalAppsV1Lifecycle_PKG specifically -- NOT because platform-specific create routing is unavailable (internal/mockserver's selectInternalApplicationFixture DOES route by file_name, and does select this exact file for a .pkg-suffixed file_name -- see TestChunkHandler_InternalApplication_PkgFileName_ServesPkgFixture), but because that lifecycle test's own CreateInternalApplication call deliberately omits FileName (same design choice already made for the apk/msi/ipa siblings -- see generated_internalappsv1_lifecycle_test.go's ARCHITECTURE NOTE doc comment), so it falls through to the pre-existing shared internal-application-response.json fixture instead of this one. This fixture is real, correctly wired into the router, and used when a caller's create request DOES set a file_name ending in .pkg -- just not by this particular lifecycle test's create step.
